The '''Anavill Smuggler's Guild''' was a loosely-allied association of independent [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who oversaw spice distribution throughout the [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]]. They were formed by [[Parmella Trillidor]] after she split from the [[Kibilini Smugglers' Guild]], and were one of the three organizations that formed [[Mandroxan]].
